tasks.label: adb: wipe app data (pm clear, all devices)
tasks.command: $adb = 'C:\Users\KWD\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe'; $pkg = 'com.ivor.kriptex'; $devices = & $adb devices | Select-String '\tdevice$' | ForEach-Object { ($_.Line -split '\t')[0] }; if (-not $devices) { throw 'No adb devices attached.' }; foreach ($d in $devices) { Write-Host ('pm clear on ' + $d); & $adb -s $d shell pm clear $pkg | Out-Null }

tasks.label: adb: clean reinstall latest debug APK (all devices)
tasks.command: $adb = 'C:\Users\KWD\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe'; $pkg = 'com.ivor.kriptex'; $apk = (Get-ChildItem "${workspaceFolder}\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\*.apk" | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; if (-not $apk) { throw 'No debug APK found. Run the build task first.' }; $devices = & $adb devices | Select-String '\tdevice$' | ForEach-Object { ($_.Line -split '\t')[0] }; if (-not $devices) { throw 'No adb devices attached.' }; foreach ($d in $devices) { Write-Host ('Reinstalling on ' + $d + ' from ' + $apk); & $adb -s $d shell am force-stop $pkg | Out-Null; & $adb -s $d uninstall $pkg | Out-Null; & $adb -s $d install -g "$apk" }

tasks.label: build + adb: assembleDebug then clean reinstall
dependsOn: adb: clean reinstall latest debug APK (all devices)
